alternatives.option: Drop `events` from V3_CLI_VERBS and let 02c's reader serve both binaries
alternatives.reason_rejected: loses the JSON envelope contract on the twining CLI and the live-log fields (kind/record/producer filters) lane 03's verb provides
breaks ADR §10.7 — the rolled-back archive must stay listable with no database, which lane 03's verb cannot do

context: Merged lane/03-runtime into foundation/v3; resolved the events-verb collision between lanes 02c and 03, and fixed the signing ceremony producing rulings its own admission rule quarantined.
rationale: Both lanes claimed the word `events` with incompatible contracts: 02c prints plain text with an exit code and needs no database (that is what keeps a rolled-back store inspectable under ADR §10.7), 03 returns the single JSON envelope the `twining` CLI promises. classifyCliArgv checked KNOWN_SUBCOMMANDS first, so 03's verb was shadowed and its 'every v3 verb routes away from the registry' test failed. V3_CLI_VERBS is now checked first on that entry point only; classifyArgv (twining-mcp) is untouched, and runEvents returns STORE_ROLLED_BACK naming `twining-mcp events` instead of reporting a rolled-back store as never-migrated.
summary: On the `twining` CLI, `events` routes to lane 03's JSON-envelope v3 verb; on `twining-mcp` it stays lane 02c's database-free archive reader, and the v3 verb names that reader when the store is rolled back
